This project prints a per-owner total report. Read the code under src/ first, then add a `--top N` option, end to end. The contract, exactly: `parseArgs` gains a `top` field that is null when the option is absent and a positive integer when given; a non-integer or a value below 1 is refused with an error mentioning `top`. `compute.js` exports a new function `topN(entries, n)` that returns the first n entries and returns them all when n is null or larger than the list. The limit is applied AFTER sorting, never before. `index.js` wires it through. The table must keep aligning to the widest owner it actually PRINTS, not to one that was dropped. Existing behaviour must not change: with no --top, every owner still prints. Run `node tests/report.test.js` to check you have not broken what is there.
